tools.name: coverage
tools.description: Free. Cities covered today, permit counts, date range and last update time.

tools.name: sample_permits
tools.description: Free. Three recent permits, to see the record format before paying.

tools.name: search_permits
tools.description: Search new building permits by trade, job value, date, zip or city. Newest first, up to 25 per call. Price: $0.02 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: get_permit
tools.description: One permit and every change recorded to its status, value or issue date. Price: $0.01 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: property_history
tools.description: Every permit recorded at one street address, newest first. Price: $0.05 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

tools.name: contractor_history
tools.description: Every permit a contractor has pulled, with total job value and counts by trade. Price: $0.10 per call (x402, USDC on Base).
